    Friday, Oct 2 - 7:30pm

    Zodiac Killer Project

    With Charlie Shackleton & David Osit

    From a chocolate biscuit to the Zodiac Killer. What happens when the filmmaker tells you exactly what they’re doing.

    Thursday, Oct 1 - 7:30pm

    Fall of Freedom — Under Pressure: How to Document
    “Unprecedented Times”

    With Rachel Lauren Mueller, Laura Poitras, and Jad Abumrad

    How do documentary makers continue to work critically, responsibly, and safely in a rapidly shifting political landscape, and one that is increasingly threatening to those organizing and documenting on the ground?

    Sunday, Oct 4 - 7:30pm

    Under the Sky of Fetishes

    With Caroline Déodat & Yasmina Price

    Moving between archive and fabulation, Déodat follows the traces of histories that refuse to disappear.

    News
    • September 10 is the last day to apply for the Doclisboa x UNDO: Filmmaking Seminar 2026!
    • We're delighted to co-present an evening with Carl Elsaesser on special effects in nonfiction with the Rockaway Film Festival on Sep 5!
    • To Use a Mountain, from UnionDocs Collaborative Studio alums Casey Carter, Colleen Cassingham & Magdalena Orellana, screens at DCTV on August 21!
    • Applications for the Andrew Berends Film Fellowship are open 'til August 15!
    • Barriga Llena, Corazón Contento (Full Belly, Happy Heart), a film made in the UNDO CoLAB by Jordana Rubenstein-Edberg & Marshall Hanig screens at Rooftop Films as part of New York Non-Fiction 2026 on July 31!
    • UNDO CoLAB Alum Laurie Sumiye has a NY premiere of their documentary, A Paradise Lost, which UnionDocs fiscally sponsored, running at DCTV July 31 - Aug 6!
    • Working on a documentary project? Apply to UnionDocs' Fiscal Sponsorship Program to access grant opportunities, accept tax-deductible donations, and receive nonprofit administrative support as you bring your work to life!
    • Steve Maing's The Great Experiment, a project fiscally sponsored by UNDO is having its NYC Premiere at Doc NYC's Selects next week, July 28th at IFC Center!
    • Applications for the Fondazione Prada Film Fund are open! Deadlines: August 6, September 10, November 20.
    • The Flaherty Film Seminar is hiring an Executive Director!
    • UnionDocs heads to Berlin for the third edition of Cinema of Commoning!
    • The Grierson-Percy Documentary Grant is accepting applications 'til June 30!
    • The Sundance Institute Documentary Fund is accepting applications 'til June 15!
    • The Made of Truth: BFI Doc Society Short Film Fund is accepting applications 'til July 1!
